description: Defines the WKProvisionalPage class which manages network requests and frame handling for a WebKit page in the Playwright project.

classes.name: WKProvisionalPage
classes.description: Manages network requests, frame attachment, and event handling for a WebKit page.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the WKProvisionalPage with session and page, sets up event listeners, and starts session initialization.

methods.name: coopNavigationRequest
methods.description: Returns the current cross-origin opener policy navigation request, if any.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes all event listeners associated with this page.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Attaches the main frame ID to the page, signaling readiness.

methods.name: _onRequestWillBeSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a network request is about to be sent, possibly adopting a request from a new process.

methods.name: _onLoadingFinished
methods.description: Handles the event when loading finishes, clearing the coop navigation request.

methods.name: _onLoadingFailed
methods.description: Handles loading failure events, clearing the coop navigation request.

methods.name: _handleFrameTree
methods.description: Sets the main frame ID based on the frame tree structure.
